entities.summary: Azahari bin Husin, also known as Azahari Husin or Azhari Husin, was a Malaysian engineer and former university lecturer who was believed to be the technical mastermind behind the series of terrorist attacks in Indonesia in the early 2000s. Nicknamed the "Demolition Man" by Malaysian newspapers, he was one of the most wanted men in Indonesia along with Noordin Mohammad Top.
